title: Experiment Variation: Single-Turn vs. Multi-Turn AI Security Analysis

original_idea.body:
# Experiment Variation: Single-Turn vs. Multi-Turn AI Security Analysis

**Problem:** AI vulnerability analysis can be conducted in a single prompt or through iterative multi-turn dialogue (analyst asks follow-up questions). Multi-turn analysis may improve detection quality but at higher cost.

**Direction:** Design a single-turn vulnerability detection protocol and a multi-turn (3-round) protocol. Run both on 20 CVEs with an LLM. Measure: detection rate, false positive rate, explanation quality, and token cost. Compute efficiency frontier.

**Why it matters:** ALOHA's 3-hour vs. weeks advantage may partly reflect multi-turn reasoning. Understanding the cost-benefit of multi-turn analysis enables optimal deployment.

**Relevant context:** ALOHA (PNNL/Anthropic 2026) uses multi-step reasoning chains. AIxCC systems also use multi-step analysis. Direct comparison of single vs. multi-turn security analysis not published.
